snippet.title: Garden Souls | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🌸 Wishlist Garden Souls on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4362210/Garden_Souls/

Watch Garden Souls, a fast-paced 2D action roguelite featuring stylish combos, elemental magic, and unique build possibilities.

Choose one of four Garden Princesses and combine melee attacks, elemental spells, and powerful Strikers to create your own combat style. Unlock new abilities, mix different elements, and adapt your build every run as you battle through a beautifully corrupted floral world.

If you enjoy games like Spiritfall, Astral Ascent, Hades, or stylish character action combat, Garden Souls offers responsive gameplay, creative builds, challenging boss fights, and rewarding progression with every run.

💬 Which Garden Princess would you choose first? Let us know in the comments!

Join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/t3Mhmstjpj

Visit our website:
https://staterastudio.com/
